_meta.authored_before: Written before the rules-only baseline or the AI-assisted workflow were implemented or run. Do not edit after results are seen; corrections go in a new file with a reason.
_meta.author: Candidate (human judgement from the assignment PDF rules and the booking register)

scoring.correct_next_action: action_code matches AND contact_channel matches (calling a customer who asked not to be called is a wrong action)
scoring.missing_info: every key in must_flag_missing is reflected in the missing_information list (keyword match on the listed synonyms)
scoring.unsupported_promise: draft or action asserts a fact the register/messages do not support (see forbidden list and evidence.py detector)

cases.rationale: Elder alone from 09:10 with no recorded cover; register says arrival unconfirmed. Customer asked for a call (M01) and Sales forwarded the callback (M07). Duty Ops calls now; Sourcing checks the caregiver / a replacement; no ETA until Sourcing records it.
Customer confirmed at 08:46 that the helper arrived and asked to close. Close; no callback. Register still says 'Arrival pending' so it should be updated.
Customer says Sales told them it was approved; register says under review with no approval or payout date; Sales note M09 sees no decision. Billing verifies; holding reply must not confirm approval.
Hinglish request to move tomorrow's (24 Nov) cook from 08:00 to 10:00 and to check with her first. Sourcing must confirm with the helper; Duty Ops acknowledges without promising.
Prospect comparing options. Sales owns quotes; no rate card exists so no amount may be stated.
Active childcare gap but the sister covers until 11:30 (M12). Customer said WhatsApp, don't call. Chase Sourcing; WhatsApp update; no promise of a substitute.

No booking reference; customer has two bookings. HSR matches B101 and B104 but locality alone is insufficient. Keep open, ask for the booking number or registered phone. High because it may be a same-day service.
Register: Rs 2,000 refund approved, payout date pending. Coordinator may relay the approval and amount; Billing confirms the payout date.
